title.text: The yoghurt that had no place

runs.text: The program reads a type of product (1 normal, 2 expires soon, 3 on a 25 % offer, 4 both) and its price, and shows the final price. A product that expires soon sells at half price. Type 4 does not work: it is charged as a normal product. Rewrite the program so that the traits combine, without changing the prices of the other types.
The product holds its traits inside, instead of having a particular case for each combination.
